exposure: absence of additional medical or obstetric conditions
cohort: The study participants were mothers who gave birth at Hawassa University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital in Ethiopia between July 2015 and June 2020.
finding: Lack of ANC, inadequate ANC, gravidity of five or more, obstructed labor, and fetal macrosomia (fetal weight >4kg) were significantly associated with an increased odds of uterine rupture.
